items.headline: Feeling 'great' at practice
items.description: Nabers (knee) said Thursday that he "felt great" after practicing Wednesday for the first time since having his torn ACL surgically repaired in October, Matt Citak of the Giants' official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: Clicks with Maye on Thursday
items.description: During Thursday's padded practice, Brown and QB Drake Maye routinely connected throughout the session, Mark Daniels of MassLive.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: Back in San Francisco
items.description: Samuel and the 49ers agreed on a one-year, $7 million contract Thursday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: In battle for No. 2 role
items.description: Richardson is in a competition for the backup quarterback role in Indianapolis ahead of the 2026 campaign, JJ Stankevitz of the Colts' official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: Signing four-year extension
items.description: Olave is signing a four-year extension worth up to $132 million, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
